clips.title: The story
paras: Madame Eva of Darkshire offers to craft a protective ward known as the Totem of Infliction for travelers passing through the shadowed woods. By harvesting remains from the ghouls, skeletons, and venomous spiders haunting the region, she enchants a charm that retaliates against attackers. The task serves as both a grim test of survival and a superstitious safeguard against the pervasive darkness of Duskwood.

Within her candle-lit abode in Darkshire, Madame Eva peers past the veil into the fortunes of those who cross her threshold. Sensing impending danger and violence waiting patiently on the horizon, she offers more than mere divination: practical sorcery. By gathering ten ghoul fangs, ten skeleton fingers, and five vials of spider venom from the haunted thickets, an adventurer supplies the raw materials needed to construct a protective ward against Duskwood's ravenous predators.

Ghoul fangs steeped in necrotizing hunger, finger bones wrested from restless dead, and potent arachnid venom are woven together by Madame Eva's enchantments. When grasped in times of mortal peril, the totem radiates a magical aura designed to reflect cruelty, inflicting spiritual and physical harm upon anyone foolish enough to strike its bearer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, friend. The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble adventurer, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom. For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very wise of you, friend. This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout Azeroth and beyond. When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura. Be brave, fair adventurer. You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
